en_title: Wardogs Dev Holding Back Certain Features Because of Xbox Series S, but Working to 'Very Low-End Hardware' Has Its Benefits
subtitle: 限制也有好处
opus_summary: 《Wardogs》开发商称，XBOX Series S限制了动态天气等功能，但也推动了低配置PC的性能优化。主机版将于2028年推出，第2赛季于10月15日上线。

paragraphs.en: The developer of Wardogs has admitted that the limitations of the Xbox Series S have stopped it from adding certain things to the game, but insisted these limits have also provided some unique benefits.
paragraphs.cn: 《Wardogs》开发商承认，XBOX Series S的硬件限制让团队无法在游戏中加入某些内容，但强调这些限制也带来了一些独特的好处。

paragraphs.en: During a press conference for Wardogs Season 2, Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer said the team is "limited" by the Xbox Series S and revealed that this is one of the reasons why the game doesn't have dynamic weather right now. The new rain feature being added to Wardogs this month will be persistent throughout a match, meaning a storm won't suddenly roll through halfway through a game and lighten up within 15 minutes. It's a constant downpour.
paragraphs.cn: 在《Wardogs》第2赛季的新闻发布会上，Bulkhead首席执行官Joe Brammer表示，团队受到XBOX Series S的「限制」，这也是游戏目前没有动态天气的原因之一。《Wardogs》本月新增的降雨功能会让雨势持续整场对局，而不是在比赛中途突然迎来暴风雨，又在15分钟内转小。整场比赛都会下着大雨。

paragraphs.en: "We are limited, as every dev is, by Xbox Series S," said Brammer. "As great a platform as Xbox is, it's a very low-end hardware for a game like Wardogs. We have to be mindful of these things we're putting in the game now. Performance is the reason we don't do it, but we would love to see it at some point. There's an ambition for it, but nobody is working on it right now."
paragraphs.cn: Brammer说：「和所有开发者一样，我们也受到XBOX Series S的限制。XBOX这个平台固然很出色，但对于《Wardogs》这样的游戏来说，Series S的硬件配置非常低端。我们必须谨慎考虑现在加入游戏的这些内容。我们没有做动态天气，是出于性能考虑，但我们很希望有朝一日能实现它。我们有这个愿望，不过目前没有人在开发这项功能。」

paragraphs.en: Bulkhead isn't the first team to acknowledge difficulties around Microsoft's cheaper console, which launched alongside the Xbox Series X in November 2020. Moon Studio founder Thomas Mahler stated earlier this year that it was delaying No Rest for the Wicked's Xbox release due to troubles with the Xbox Series S . Baldur's Gate 3 also came to Xbox a few months late and required the help of Microsoft's engineers to get the game's split-screen co-op working on Series S .
paragraphs.cn: XBOX Series S是微软旗下价格较低的主机，于2020年11月与XBOX Series X一同推出。Bulkhead并不是第一支承认在这台主机上遇到困难的团队。Moon Studio创始人Thomas Mahler今年早些时候表示，由于在XBOX Series S上遇到问题，团队推迟了《恶意不息》XBOX版的发售。《博德之门3》也晚了几个月才登陆XBOX，而且需要微软工程师协助，才能让游戏的分屏合作模式在Series S上运行。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, one of the questions facing Microsoft ever since the release of the Xbox Series S is whether it would be willing to allow developers and publishers to release a game on Xbox Series X only, leaving Xbox Series S behind. As it stands, Xbox mandates that video games launch on both or none at all, and that there should be main feature parity between each version.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，自XBOX Series S推出以来，微软一直面临一个问题：是否愿意允许开发商和发行商只在XBOX Series X上推出游戏，不再兼顾XBOX Series S。目前，XBOX要求游戏必须同时登陆这两款主机，否则就都不能发行，而且两个版本的主要功能应保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Although Wardogs isn't coming to console until 2028 , Bulkhead is hyper-aware of how everything it puts in the game could impact consoles in the future. In a follow-up interview exclusive to IGN, studio co-founder Howard Philpott echoed sentiments about possibly adding dynamic weather in the future, but noted Bulkhea would have to handle it carefully to avoid tanking performance. He added that, while Series S has its pitfalls, it also lets the developer optimize the game for lower-end PCs.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然《Wardogs》要到2028年才会登陆主机，但Bulkhead始终格外留意，加入游戏的每一项内容未来可能会对主机版产生怎样的影响。在随后接受IGN独家采访时，工作室联合创始人Howard Philpott也表示，未来可能会加入动态天气，但指出Bulkhead必须谨慎处理，以免性能大幅下降。他补充说，Series S虽然有不足之处，但也让开发团队能够为低配置PC优化游戏。

paragraphs.en: "As for Series S, Joe is right, and it's not an industry secret or anything," he said. "It is holding back what developers can do in terms of pushing the boundaries because it's so far behind par in terms of the rest of the power of the rest of the consoles. So yeah, it's something we have to be cognizant of, but at the same time, Series S does actually give us that baseline performance.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「至于Series S，Joe说得没错，这也不是什么行业秘密。它确实限制了开发者突破技术边界的能力，因为它的性能远远落后于其他主机。所以，我们确实必须留意这一点，但与此同时，Series S也确实为我们提供了一个性能基准。

paragraphs.en: "We were so heavy [during] pre-release in terms of talking about performance for PC, and what we didn't necessarily talk about [during the] press conference was how much Series S drove us to make the performance good on lower-spec PCs, because the goal is to get everyone to be able to play with all of their friends. There's an obvious financial benefit to that, so it's not completely altruistic, but at the same time, it is the goal. That is the point of the game: being able to play with as many people as possible."
paragraphs.cn: 「在发售前，我们花了很多篇幅谈PC性能，但在新闻发布会上，我们没有怎么谈到Series S在多大程度上推动了我们改善低配置PC的运行表现。我们的目标是让每个人都能和自己的所有朋友一起玩。这显然也有经济上的好处，所以并不完全是出于无私，但与此同时，这确实是我们的目标。这就是这款游戏的意义：能和尽可能多的人一起玩。」

paragraphs.en: Philpott also noted that Bulkhead has always imagined Wardogs as a multi-platform game. The team recognized there was heavy demand for controller support prior to Wardogs' early access launch, prompting them to quickly put something together. He stated that this support is in "an okay serviceable state, but really it needs to be a lot better." Senior producer Kane Allard noted that situation has prompted Bulkhead to be more "forward thinking."
paragraphs.cn: Philpott还指出，Bulkhead一直将《Wardogs》设想为一款多平台游戏。在《Wardogs》开启抢先体验之前，团队发现玩家对手柄支持的需求很强烈，于是迅速做出了相应功能。他表示，目前的手柄支持「还算能用，但确实需要大幅改进」。高级制作人Kane Allard指出，这件事促使Bulkhead更「着眼长远」。

paragraphs.en: "I think that's a good example of one of the things that bit us a bit and made us realize actually we do need to be forward thinking," said Allard. "We made the decision, as Howard said, originally we were releasing on PC for early access, and it was kind of an afterthough, we need to have controller support. And then we realized there was a massive outcry for it, and we had to look back at the systems we had and try and make them work with controller, and there was a fair amount of work there. And yeah, we did do it in the end and it was a little bit of a slog, but that did burn us a bit. And we then realized, yeah, we need to be really smart, build stuff with console in mind, with controller in mind, and we're taking that forward for everything that we put in the game."
paragraphs.cn: Allard说：「我觉得这就是一个很好的例子：我们在这件事上吃了点亏，也因此意识到，确实需要考虑得更长远。正如Howard所说，我们最初决定在PC上推出抢先体验版，后来才想到需要支持手柄。接着，我们发现玩家对此呼声很高，只好回头审视已有的系统，想办法让它们适配手柄，这需要做相当多的工作。我们最终确实做到了，过程有些艰难，也让我们吃了点苦头。随后我们意识到，必须更明智地做开发，在构建内容时就考虑主机和手柄。今后加入游戏的所有内容，我们都会沿用这个思路。」

paragraphs.en: It will be a while before Wardogs makes its way to consoles, but this is a major part of the game's journey. Philpott also said that Bulkhead hired a pro Halo player to help with controller support and ensuring that it gets an extra level of care.
paragraphs.cn: 《Wardogs》距离登陆主机还有一段时间，但这也是游戏发展历程中的重要一环。Philpott还表示，Bulkhead聘请了一名《光环》职业选手，协助手柄支持的开发，确保团队在这方面投入更多心力。

paragraphs.en: Wardogs Season 2 will launch next week on October 15.
